title: Small subspace with low-degree Fourier regularity
statement: Let $k,n$ be nonnegative integers with $1\\le k\\le n$. There is a linear subspace $A\\subseteq(\\mathbb{F}_2)^n$ with $|A|\\le 2^k n^{k-1}$ such that the uniform probability density on $A$, transported to the sign cube, has every nonempty Fourier coefficient indexed by a set of size at most $k$ equal to zero.
